selected_evidence.requirement: Publish node2's port 8080 app through node1 so node3 can reach it
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node1's eth0 IP (10.100.70.10:8080) returns the app's response 'hello from node2 app on port 8080'; VyOS shows the DNAT rule and matching forward-filter rule active.

selected_evidence.requirement: Do not open the rest of the private network to node3
selected_evidence.summary: From node3: direct curl to node2's private IP (10.50.50.11:8080) returns nothing/000, ping to 10.50.50.11 has 100% loss (no route), other ports on node1 (8081) are refused. Only the forwarded 8080 flow succeeds.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d... and active NAT/firewall rules captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 2f077803...; NAT/firewall config persisted and confirmed active; end-to-end curl from node3 succeeded post-reboot.
